title: Canada’s Retaliatory Tariffs Set to Take Effect as Trump Threatens to Escalate
partialText: New Canadian levies of up to 50 percent are expected to begin Tuesday, even as Washington warns of a new round of American tariffs.

title: Trump’s Trade War Is Shaping the Fight for Congress

title: As War Grinds On, Trump Relishes Renovation Projects

title: Ousted Kennedy Center Chairman Buys Dismantled ‘Blue’ Sculpture

title: Trump Posts Map Suggesting New Mexico Be Renamed as ‘New America’
partialText: The suggestion, posted on social media, appeared to be the latest in the president’s efforts to alter geographic names.

title: Germany’s ‘Firewall’ Against the Far Right Is Being Tested as Never Before
partialText: A blowout win by the far-right Alternative for Germany party in a state election has revealed a split among voters about whether to uphold a decades-old strategy for sidelining extremists.

title: After Victory in German State, Far Right Needs Help to Take Power
partialText: The Alternative for Germany, or AfD, does not have a straightforward path to governing Saxony-Anhalt, but a small populist party could clear the way.

title: Officials Search for Answers After Fatal Miami Airport Cargo Plane Crash
partialText: The cargo plane, operated for Amazon, plowed into a public road and crashed into vehicles, killing five people and disrupting more than 200 flights over Labor Day weekend.

title: What to Know About Cargo Plane That Overran Its Runway, Killing 5 in Miami
partialText: The plane was operating as part of Amazon’s cargo fleet and had flown from Puerto Rico. It crashed into several vehicles after overrunning the runway.

title: Bears in Los Angeles Are Getting Their Close-Ups, Ready or Not
partialText: California has 60,000 black bears, and they are venturing far from their usual habitat in search of food and shelter. It’s the humans who have to adapt.

title: There Is Still a Void at Ground Zero. Here’s How We Fill It.

title: Why Amy Klobuchar Wants to Run a State Beleaguered by Trump
partialText: The senator opted to run for governor, having concluded that many Minnesotans lost faith in state government under fellow Democrats. But some wonder: Would she be a fighter in the role, or a conciliator?

title: 5 Races to Watch This Fall for Answers to the Biggest Midterm Questions

title: Social Media in China Is Getting Really Dark

title: Can Andre Agassi Enjoy Pickleball More Than He Hated Tennis?

title: The Film Industry Is Worried About Survival. France Wants to Save the Day.

title: Thousands of Serbs Gather to Mourn Ratko Mladic, the ‘Butcher of Bosnia’
partialText: The government insisted the funeral was a private affair, even as government ministers attended and state-controlled news media lavished praise on the convicted war criminal.
